specs.note: The cell has two parts: the AMS-fed list, then "Bypass Filament Outlet: TPE, generic TPU, Bambu PET-CF/TPU 95A, and other filament that contains carbon fiber or glass fiber"; those items carry "(Bypass Filament Outlet)" here. specs.conflict_note:
Same materials as the store page row (messages.SpecificationTable.filamentSupported), which parses the cell as one comma list: its items "and TPU for AMS.
Bypass Filament Outlet: TPE" and "and other filament that contains carbon fiber or glass fiber." keep the markup and the "and", the Bambu groups stay single items, and the bypass items lose their qualifier. Here the Bambu groups are split and the bypass items are marked.

specs.quote: Voltage DC: 24 V AC: 100 V–240 V~
specs.note: The sheet lists Voltage and Average Power inside its Drying group. Region left empty: the official sheet gives one universal AC range (100–240 V, so 220 V included), not a US 100–120 V table (§C.6). The AC input is the AMS HT's own power cord, which the drying function needs (AMS HT Part Introduction › Power Cable; Multi-model guide › AMS HT Drying Power Requirements).

specs.quote: Voltage DC: 24 V AC: 100 V–240 V~, 50 Hz/60 Hz
specs.note: The frequency of the AC input (same cell as the voltage). Region left empty for the same reason as electrical.voltage. The cached pdftotext -layout text splits each "Hz" into "H" and a stray "z" (the quote checker reports not_found); pdftotext -raw of the same cached PDF reads "AC:100 V–240 V~, 50 Hz/60 Hz", and the rendered page shows "AC: 100 V–240 V~, 50 Hz/60 Hz". The store page row (messages …voltageACValue) gives the same words.

specs.quote: Average Power 150 W
specs.note: The sheet's label is "Average Power", listed inside its Drying group. The drying guide (Hardware Function Introduction › Drying Module) names a 170 W heater; that is the heater's rating, not the unit's maximum input, so it is not stored as electrical.max_power.

notes: Adjudication against the second extraction (100 field disagreements): the bypass-outlet items of printing.supported_filament keep the "(Bypass Filament Outlet)" qualifier form; ams.max_units stays the bare count per printer option value (the template field is a number), with the rest in test_condition; the Voltage and Average Power locators keep the sheet's Drying group (the rendered sheet puts both rows under Drying); connectivity.interface keeps "power and communication" (the guide's own words); compatibility keeps the compat-targets labels and kinds (A1 Series, X1 Series, P1 Series, P2S and H2D are families; H2S, H2C, X2D and A2L printers) with their handles; requirement labels follow compat-targets requirement_targets; the in-the-box locators keep "What’s in the Box › n". Taken from the second: ams.slots is unverified (inferred from the colour arithmetic, never stated as a count), electrical.requirements (the AMS HT Drying Power Requirements sentence), package.contents from the store page, and not_published electrical.standby_power. Kept from the first: the A1 Series AMS Hub requirement from the AMS HT guide's own sentence, the generic 4-in-1 PTFE Adapter target for X2D (the page says both "standard" and "adapter II"; recorded in its note), and not_published physical.operating_temp (the drying guide's 10 °C–25 °C is the condition for reaching 85 °C, not an operating range). Not added: an "other" relation for A1 firmware 01.07.00.00 (not a product; kept in the A1 relation's note) and a separate H2 Series Dedicated adapter relation on the H2D/H2C 3+ variant (the H2D may use either version; recorded in that relation's note).
